How to Play

Goal: the Robo-Goons stole the community's crypto vault! Fight through 5 big stages like a movie, jungle, desert, harbor, a frozen crypto mine and the Sky Vault, take back the BTC, ETH and $DLI, rescue the caged Dlicom team and smash each stage's boss. Watch the talking scenes: tap to advance the dialogue. A rescued teammate fights beside you for the rest of the run. You have 3 lives, a fall always sends you back to the mid-stage 🚩 checkpoint with full hearts. Grab ❤ hearts for extra lives.

Combos & loot: chain kills to raise your combo to ×2, ×3, ×5. Dodge a bullet by a hair for a "So close! +50" bonus. Smash 📦 crates and goons for power-ups: Spread Shot, 🛡️ Shield, ×2 Coins and 🧲 Coin Magnet. Watch for surprise events, coin rain, pigeon airstrikes and the legendary Golden Goon worth a fortune!

PC: ◀ ▶ / A D move · ▼ / S crouch (dodges straight shots, keep firing!) · ▲ / W aim up · Space / Z fire · X / K jump · C / L grenade · P pause · M sound · F fullscreen. Gamepad works too. Drones overhead? Just fire, Dili auto-aims up at them.

Phone: drag the joystick (◀ ▶ move, push ▲ to jump, push ▼ to crouch) and use the FIRE, JUMP, BOMB and CROUCH buttons.

Boss tips: jump the Juggernaut's shockwaves, dodge the Mauler's stinger, melt Frostbite before he freezes your coins, and keep moving under Captain Moonbags, he drops bombers. Clear the story to unlock the bragging rights, then chase your Best in ♾️ Endless Mode.
